_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Keyboard shortcuts: a terminal of another conversation does not swallow opening the current one's. Terminals render with ghostty. The browser is a 1280x900 desktop window. "Press K on X" means: focus X with an eval calling X.focus(), then press K (for example "Control+Shift+D" is the key "D" with modifiers Control+Shift, and "Control+Backquote" is the key "`" with modifier Control). "The message input" is data-testid "message-input"; "the terminal input" is the element with role "textbox" and accessible name exactly "Terminal input" that is visible; "focused" means it is document.activeElement. Call "second" starts a second conversation in the same directory and sets {{SECOND}} to its ID; call "terminals" returns how many of the server's terminals belong to conversation {{SECOND}}. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: there should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-running". 3. Call "second". 4. Navigate to /c/{{SECOND}}: ".terminal-panel" should be hidden (absent or not visible). 5. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused, and there should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-running". 6. Call "terminals" until it returns "1".
